clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope  -  Requirements of microalloyed steels of different strength levels for use in structural work. The steels may be suitable for other application also.

clauses.title: Grades – It shall
clauses.text: 2. Grades - It  shall be in 10 grades given in Table 1.

clauses.title: Freedom from Defects
clauses.text: 3. Freedom from Defects— The finished material shall be free from surface defects, such as pits, rolled in scales, deep scratches, grooves, laminations, cracks, rough jagged and imperfect edges, and any other harmful defects.
